notepad_final: Hypotheses: 7 marks/handles/anchors. Objects live on coarse 5x5 tile grid. Arrow moves shift the active hollow brown 5x5 frame when movable/parked; RIGHT after reset confirmed arrows control this frame, not the top-left sample. Top-left sample seems inert: SELECT from clearly parked-right-of-sample did nothing. SELECT near lower-right blue/red target also did nothing. Around central cyan cluster, SELECT can sometimes toggle parked-adjacent <-> deployed-around a cyan block; deployed frames often seemed immobile. In parked state, LEFT/RIGHT may cycle the parked selector/frame between adjacent central positions. Important correction: a hollow 5x5 3-border in open space can be the movable frame itself with empty interior, not necessarily enclosing a block. Another negative: SELECT from frame parked immediately LEFT of LEFTMOST central cyan block showed no visible change. Strongest current evidence: while deployed, LEFT cycles the brown surround across the three central cyan blocks (rightmost -> middle -> leftmost). Current board now appears to show the LEFTMOST central cyan block enclosed by the brown 3-border. Best next test: SELECT from this leftmost deployed state.

Play area = tiled room; controllable piece = hollow 5x5 square whose movement shifts by one 5x5 tile. Upper-left blue/red 9/8 sprite seems static scenery, not the main objective. Bottom-right patterned 2-tile has shown no visible effect from entering/selecting from tested sides, so it is likely inactive or not the immediate objective. Central blue 5x5 structures are enterable/selectable and seem to be the main objective; selecting at least the first and middle previously changed their state. Selecting the rightmost may cause a soft-lock or hidden state. Reset appears to restore the initial board without clearing notes. Trust raw grid over ambiguous readouts. Raw-grid mapping: player on floor = separate 3-border with 0 interior; standing on a structure = hollow border overlaying an 8-block; activated structures can show 3-borders with 8 interiors. Movement heuristics: if player is left of cluster with one full 5x5 floor gap before the leftmost structure, move right into that gap first; if then directly adjacent, move right onto the leftmost structure. Mirror on right side: if player is right of cluster with one full 5x5 floor gap before the rightmost structure, move left into that gap first; if then directly adjacent, move left onto the rightmost/adjacent structure. If no separate nearby 3/0 floor-square is visible and pattern is left 4/8, middle 3/8, right 4/8, player is likely on the middle structure. Repeated select on middle may create a bad anomalous global 3-row; if that happens, try undo/reset and then ignore the bottom row, relying on local cluster/player patterns. If player is several tiles below the cluster, keep moving up until re-aligned. New correction: if player instead appears near the upper-left 9/8 scenery while the three 4/8 structures are clearly several tiles below/right, move down toward the structures. New direct-adjacency rule: if the player 3/0 square is immediately left of the leftmost structure with no floor gap, move right onto that structure; if immediately right of the rightmost with no floor gap, move left onto that structure. Symmetric vertical rule: if player is clearly above the cluster by multiple tile-steps, keep moving down until re-aligned.

L1: select turned the bottom-right corner 3->5, implying a hidden active focus. Up from the far-right extended the bottom-row 5 run, dropped the right-side 2-pattern lower, and raised the left 3-block upward in stages until it aligned beside the top-left 9/8 box. Down from that aligned state lowers the left 3-block; undo restores the aligned state. Select/right while aligned showed no local visible change for a long time, but repeated rights steadily extended the bottom-row 5 trail leftward by about 1 cell each move, with no visible interaction near the right 2-pattern or center 7s. Step 42-79: this persisted. Endpoint reaction: once the sweep reached far enough left, the far-left section of the bottom row transformed into a long strip of 2s. One more right then turned that 2-strip into 4s instead of continuing the extension, suggesting an endpoint/stall or completed circuit. Select from the 4-state changed the left segment back to 2, likely a charged/active version. Up from the charged 2-strip showed no clear visible interaction; undo restores that charged state. Down from the charged 2-strip also failed to reveal a useful new interaction. Step 98-113: left from the charged 2-strip shrank it from the right edge by about one cell per move while the top-left 3-block stayed aligned. Exhausting the strip triggered a major transformation: the left 3-block dropped below the 9/8 box and the entire bottom row turned into 3s. Select from the near-endpoint charged state appears to trigger that same transformation immediately. Step 120-197: the transformed state persisted across multiple undo/reset/up/select attempts. Repeated right from the transformed state steadily expands the far-right 5 segment of the bottom row leftward and slides the detached lower 3-block rightward through/against the right-side 2-pattern area, but there is still no obvious visible reaction or clear stall. Continue probing right until the motion halts or finally triggers an interaction.
